title: Explicit scalar-restricted tensor complex on an open site
statement: Let f:X→S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], U an open of X, L a complex of O_X restricted to the open site over U, and G a complex of O_X-modules. Define T by restricting G to U, taking the signed direct-sum total tensor L tensor G|_U [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and restricting scalars along the restriction to U of the canonical ring map f inverse-image O_S→O_X [def-pc-module-pullback]. Thus T is a complex of (f inverse-image O_S)|_U-modules. No perfection, flatness, bound or choice of derived representative enters this definition.
